title: Completed legacy relay migration does not replay on every startup
observed_behavior: The Tier-0 Nostr migration runner executed relay legacy backfill before the readiness bootstrapper.
Relay backfill had no durable completion marker, so every Bahia restart queried and replayed the full legacy relay history again.
Repeated migration publications timed out against multiple relays, kept readiness at bootstrap phase init, and recreated relay pressure during a guarded production canary.
The deployed database already carries the legacy terminal migration cursor at 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z with event id ~, proving the prior migration was administratively completed.
intended_behavior: A successful relay legacy backfill records a durable versioned completion marker.
Subsequent starts skip relay backfill when that marker exists.
Existing deployments with the exact legacy terminal cursor translate it into the new completion marker without replaying relay history.
Failed or rate-limited backfills never record completion.
